tools.name: browser_profiles
tools.description: List the Chrome profiles the user connected with the popup's Connect button.

tools.name: browser_connect
tools.description:
Attach to a Chrome profile the user connected in the Trusty Browser popup.

        No code is needed. With one connected profile, omit ``profile``. With
        several, call browser_profiles and pass the chosen ``profile`` id.

tools.name: browser_disconnect
tools.description: Close this agent's session; the profile stays connected until the user disconnects it.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List the tabs this grant may address, with page access, origin and title.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Lease a tab by id for this session (does not focus it); returns the lease.

tools.name: browser_switch
tools.description: Bring the leased tab to the front of its window and focus that window.

tools.name: page_read
tools.description:
Read the leased tab's page: elements with refs for click and type.

        ``scope_ref`` reads only that element's subtree; ``viewport_only`` keeps
        elements on screen; ``include_text`` adds the page (or scope) text;
        ``max_chars`` (1000-250000) bounds the reply. Elements nearest the
        viewport are kept first and ``truncated`` reports any cut (#11356).

tools.name: page_find
tools.description:
Find elements by ``role`` (exact), ``name`` and ``text`` (substrings, any case).

        Give at least one of role, name and text. ``text`` matches the
        element's own text or its container's; ``within_ref`` searches only
        inside that element. Each match carries ``in``: its nearest list, row,
        dialog, form, navigation or main, with name and ref (#11357).

tools.name: page_click
tools.description:
Click the element a page_read returned as ``ref`` with a trusted mouse click.

        ``dialog`` ("accept" or "dismiss") answers a confirm, prompt or
        beforeunload dialog the click opens; an alert is always acknowledged and
        the reply names the dialog (#11294). ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_hover
tools.description:
Move the pointer onto the element a page_read returned as ``ref``.

        Why: menus and tooltips open on hover (#11287). What: fires pointer
        and mouse over/enter/move on the element, and out/leave on the one
        hovered before. The events are synthetic, so CSS ``:hover`` does not
        match. ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.
        Test: `test_end_to_end_page_session_through_the_mcp_server`.

tools.name: page_drag
tools.description:
Drag the element ``ref`` onto ``target`` (both refs from one page_read).

        ``dropped`` is false when the target did not accept the drop. Reuse the
        request ID to retry. See #11288.

tools.name: page_type
tools.description:
Replace the text of an editable element named by ``ref``, one keystroke per character.

        A newline presses Enter (a single-line field submits its form) and a tab presses Tab.
        For a dropdown use page_select. ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_scroll
tools.description:
Scroll the leased tab, then wait up to ``wait_ms`` for new content.

        Why: offscreen and infinite-scroll content loads only on scroll (#11291).
        What: ``to`` is down or up (90% of the viewport), top, bottom, or
        element with ``ref`` from the latest page_read. The result carries
        scroll_y, scroll_height, viewport_height, grew (content was added) and
        at_end. For a feed, repeat ``to="bottom"`` until grew is false, then
        page_read again. A ref survives reads while its element keeps its role
        and name; a removed or changed element answers StaleElement (#11355).
        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.
        Test: `test_end_to_end_page_session_through_the_mcp_server`.

tools.name: page_press
tools.description:
Press one key, with optional modifiers, on ``ref`` or the focused element.

        Why: pages submit on Enter and move focus on Tab, and page handlers
        listen for key events (#11286). What: ``key`` is Enter, Tab, Escape,
        Backspace, Delete, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home,
        End, PageUp, PageDown, Space or one printable character; ``modifiers``
        is any of Shift, Control, Alt, Meta. Omit ``ref`` to press on the
        focused element. ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.
        Test: `test_end_to_end_page_session_through_the_mcp_server`.

tools.name: page_select
tools.description:
Choose an option of the native ``<select>`` named by ``ref``.

        Why: a native dropdown ignores clicks on its options and is not a
        typing target (#11285). What: ``value`` matches an option's value,
        else its label, from the ``options`` page_read lists. The reply's
        ``changed`` is false when the option was already selected or a page
        handler reverted it, and ``value`` is the select's value afterwards.
        ``NotSelectable`` and ``NoSuchOption`` refuse without changing the
        page. ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.
        Test: `test_end_to_end_page_session_through_the_mcp_server`.

tools.name: page_navigate
tools.description:
Navigate the leased tab to an https URL (or http://127.0.0.1).

        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_back
tools.description:
Go back one entry in the leased tab's history; NoHistory when there is none.

        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_forward
tools.description:
Go forward one entry in the leased tab's history; NoHistory when there is none.

        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_reload
tools.description:
Reload the leased tab's page.

        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_upload
tools.description:
Set local files on the <input type=file> named by ``ref``; the page sees a user's pick.

        ``paths`` name files under the server's --upload-root (relative to it, or
        absolute inside it), at most 10 and 512 KiB in total. Without
        --upload-root, or for a symlink or a path outside the root, it refuses.
        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_downloads
tools.description: List the newest downloads started from the leased tab's origin, with path and state.

tools.name: browser_open_tab
tools.description:
Open a new background tab at an ``https`` URL (or ``http://127.0.0.1``) and lease it to this session.

        The reply carries the ``lease`` and ``tab``, as browser_select's does. A tab grant
        answers OutOfScope (#11208). ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.description:
Close a tab this session holds a lease on.

        Any other tab, including one another session leases, answers TabNotLeased and
        stays open (#11208). A user tab leased with browser_select can be closed.
        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_screenshot
tools.description:
Capture the leased tab's viewport, or one element ``ref`` from page_read, as a PNG image.

        The reply carries a ``capture_id``, the image ``width`` and ``height``, the captured
        ``region`` in viewport CSS pixels and the ``viewport`` metrics (CSS size,
        devicePixelRatio, zoom, scroll). page_click_at and page_type_at take points in this
        image's pixels for 5 seconds, while the viewport stays the same (#11211).
        Viewport only: nothing beyond the visible area is captured. A ``ref`` scrolls
        its element into view first.

tools.name: page_click_at
tools.description:
Click with a trusted mouse click at pixel ``x``, ``y`` of the page_screenshot ``capture_id``.

        A capture older than 5 seconds, or one whose viewport, scroll, zoom or document has
        changed, answers StaleCapture; a point outside the viewport answers OutOfViewport
        (#11211). No hit-test runs: the click lands on whatever is at the point, including
        a cross-origin iframe in the leased tab. It dismisses confirm and prompt dialogs.
        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: page_type_at
tools.description:
Click at pixel ``x``, ``y`` of the page_screenshot ``capture_id``, then insert ``text`` as trusted input.

        Refuses StaleCapture and OutOfViewport as page_click_at does (#11211), with no
        hit-test, so it can type into a cross-origin iframe. ``text`` is capped at 8192
        characters and goes to the focused element; dialogs are dismissed.
        ``request_id`` is optional; pass the same id to retry.

tools.name: browser_release
tools.description: Release a lease taken with browser_select.
